{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Justice Crusader''''' was the personal [[Attack cruiser/Legends|attack cruiser]] of [[Raskta Lsu]]. The ship carried Raskta, [[Sarro Xaj]], [[Worror Dowmat]], [[Valenthyne Farfalla]] and [[Johun Othone]] to [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] when they pursued the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] and [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] engaged in a [[Duel on Tython|duel]] with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], and after their [[Death/Legends|deaths]], the ship was left abandoned on Tython.
